g.title: Phase3OperationalMVP
g.text: AI Decision Firewall - Phase 3 Operational MVP Architecture
Phase 2.5 @ 854b15c: published on main; exact-commit CI green
Phase 3: local demo/corpus candidate; exact commit and CI pending
P2-CE-005: CE-0 NOT_EVALUATED; separate from and unrelated to Phase 3

g.title: cluster_execution
g.text: synthetic_simulation only - no live connectors, credentials, or operational targets
Private mutation capability is application-level control, not OS/process/security isolation

g.title: untrusted
g.text: External AI / reasoning -> raw decision request
Never creates identity or authority; no credential, token, broker, or target access

g.title: intake
g.text: malformed, unauthenticated, unresolved, or untrusted input -> DENY record; no authorization, broker call, or effect

g.title: trusted
g.text: Resolved independently; request assertions cannot create trust

g.title: firewall
g.text: Fail closed • recommendation/confidence remain informational and never confer authority
Outcome • reasons • permitted action/parameters • policy binding • context hash

g.title: outcomes
g.text: - DENY/ESCALATE terminate before authorization; only ALLOW edges continue
Receipt returns for firewall reevaluation only

g.title: broker
g.text: Consumes before attempt; rejection fails closed

g.title: target
g.text: No public apply path • no network/live connector

g.title: observer
g.text: Does not trust the broker return value

g.title: accountability
g.text: - every path/gate emits; records behavior but never creates authority
Closed lifecycle ordering • exact correlation/binding validation • no missing terminal paths
